recovery.title: Set a new password
recovery.intro: For safety the link activates only when you press the button, so automatic scanners in your mailbox cannot consume it.

invite.title: Activate your account
invite.intro: Press the button to activate the account and choose a password.

signup.title: Confirm your email address
signup.intro: Press the button to confirm the address and sign in.

other.title: Sign in
other.intro: Press the button to complete sign-in.

confirm.missing: Incomplete link: the verification code is missing. Request a new link.
confirm.failed: The link is invalid or has expired. Request a new link.
